comparison.objective: Place four weights on a pivoted plank while keeping it balanced.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate mirrored bimanual placements of unequal weights at appropriate lever arms.
comparison.success_condition: One red and one yellow weight end on each side, reds farther out, while tilt never exceeds six degrees and the plank never leaves the ridge.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop balance and simultaneous load placement are different from adjustable-damper manipulation and repeated carriage-stop commissioning.
